findings.document_locator: An empty list means the company has no outstanding receivables. Continue to the no-receivables lending decision.
findings.consequence: Following the instruction can classify an unsynchronized, disconnected or stale company as having no receivables. The verification repeats the same error. This establishes an unreliable lending classification; the packet does not establish a release of funds or another serious downstream effect warranting critical severity.
findings.fix: Explain that invoices are the latest locally synchronized records. Before concluding no receivables, check GET /companies/{id}/sync for initialComplete and lastSuccessfulAt within the agreed one-hour window, and verify that connection state is connected. Otherwise defer the decision and show the data state. Verify both qualifying empty data and empty data failing each prerequisite.
